topic: ATHX Games Unveils USA vs Europe Competition

facts.label: Story
facts.value: ATHX Games Unveils USA vs Europe Competition

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Athletes competing in Los Angeles and Amsterdam will have their performances compared for transatlantic bragging rights ATHX Games is adding an international rivalry to its hybrid fitness competition series, pitting American athletes against their European counterparts in a cross-continental showdown this weekend. On Saturday, Nov. 7, ATHX will host competitions in Amsterdam and the Los Angeles area, with results from the two events used to determine a winner in a 15-point battle between Europe and the USA. The Amsterdam event will take place first, with European athletes setting performance benchmarks for American competitors to chase later in the day. The European team will be captained by ATHX co-founder and Marchon Gyms founder Ollie Marchon, a former professional rugby player, while celebrity trainer and fitness influencer Massy Arias will captain Team USA. Unlike a traditional head-to-head competition, athletes will participate in standard ATHX races at their respective locations, with their performances compared across 13 divisions. Each division will be scored across three signature ATHX workout zones: strength, endurance and Metcon-X. The strength zone will be decided by the highest average weight lifted across three exercises, endurance by the highest average distance covered and Metcon-X by the fastest average completion time.

topic: Longtime VersaClimber Executives Become Majority Owners of Iconic Fitness Brand

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Longtime VersaClimber Executives Become Majority Owners of Iconic Fitness Brand

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Founding family maintains a stake as company plans continued investment in innovation, education and global growth SANTA ANA, Calif. — November 4 — VersaClimber, the fitness equipment brand trusted for 45 years by elite athletes, coaches and fitness studios worldwide, today announced a transition: longtime company executives Shane Schieffer and Jim Siegrist are now VersaClimber’s majority owners. Schieffer, who has spent nearly 10 years guiding VersaClimber’s strategy, operations and product development, will serve as CEO. His role has centered on aligning what the company builds with what its customers and users need. That connection is personal: in 2025, after doing nearly all of his upper-body training on VersaClimber and relatively little swimming, he swam 140 miles through Lake Powell in just over 10 days while towing his own gear. Siegrist, who has led VersaClimber’s sales, marketing and industry relationships for nearly four years as a fractional executive, developing key partnerships with companies such as Lagree Fitness and TRX, will serve as President and Chief Revenue Officer. He brings Wall Street discipline and a rare instinct for people, building partnerships around shared principles, complementary strengths and genuine trust. The Charnitski family, which founded and led VersaClimber for 45 years, remains shareholders.

en.headline: Longtime VersaClimber Executives Become Majority Owners of Iconic Fitness Brand

topic: Aufruf zur Teilnahme an der Eckdatenstudie

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Aufruf zur Teilnahme an der Eckdatenstudie

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Hamburg, 04.11.2026 – Der DSSV e. V., Deloitte und die Deutsche Hochschule für Prävention und Gesundheitsmanagement (DHfPG) starten die diesjährige Erhebung „Eckdaten der deutschen Fitnesswirtschaft 2027“. Seit 1989 liefert die Studie fundierte Kennzahlen zur Entwicklung der deutschen Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche. Damit auch künftig ein aussagekräftiges Bild des Marktes gezeichnet werden kann, sind alle Betreiber von Fitness- und Gesundheitsanlagen in Deutschland zur Teilnahme aufgerufen. Mit 12,36 Millionen Mitgliedern, 9.647 Anlagen und einem Gesamtumsatz von 6,25 Milliarden Euro im Jahr 2025 unterstreicht die Fitnesswirtschaft ihre wirtschaftliche und gesellschaftliche Bedeutung. Gleichzeitig steht die Branche vor vielfältigen Herausforderungen: Hohe Betriebskosten, Fachkräftemangel und regulatorische Anforderungen verlangen von den Unternehmen vorausschauende Entscheidungen. Um Entwicklungen frühzeitig zu erkennen, Veränderungen einzuordnen und die Interessen der Branche wirkungsvoll zu vertreten, sind verlässliche Daten unverzichtbar. Die jährliche Studie wird gemeinsam vom DSSV e. V., Deloitte und der DHfPG durchgeführt. Sie schafft eine fundierte Grundlage für die Bewertung der Marktentwicklung und liefert wichtige Erkenntnisse für Unternehmen, Investoren sowie Entscheidungsträger aus Politik und Wirtschaft.

en.headline: Aufruf zur Teilnahme an der Eckdatenstudie
